1.1: Avot hattumot, hashsheretz, veshichvat zera, uteme met, vehammetzora bime safro, ume chattat sheen bahem kede hazzaya, hare ellu metammein adam vechelim bemagga, uchele cheres baavir, veenam metammein bemassa:
1.2: Lemala mehem, nevela, ume chattat sheyyesh bahem kede hazzaya, shehem metammein et haadam bemassa letamme vegadim bemagga, vachasuche vegadim bemagga:
1.3: Lemala mehen, boel nidda, shehu metamme mishkav tachton kaelyon. lemala mehen, zovo shel zav verukko veshichvat zaro umeme raglav, vedam hannidda, shehen metammein bemagga uvemassa. lemala mehen, merkav, shehu metamme tachat even mesama. lemala min hammerkav, mishkav, sheshshave maggao lemassao. lemala min hammishkav, hazzav, shehazzav ose mishkav, veen mishkav ose mishkav:
1.4: Lemala min hazzav, zava, shehi metammea et boalah. lemala min hazzava, metzora, shehu metamme bevia. lemala min hammetzora, etzem kasseora, shehu metamme tumat shiva. chamur mikkullam, hammet, shehu metamme veohel, ma sheen kullam metammein:
1.5: Eser tumot porshot min haadam. mechussar kippurim, asur bakkodesh umuttar batteruma uvammaaser. chazar lihyot tevul yom, asur bakkodesh uvatteruma umuttar bammaaser. chazar lihyot baal keri, asur bishlashtan. chazar lihyot boel nidda, metamme mishkav tachton kaelyon. chazar lihyot zav sheraa shete reiyyot, metamme mishkav umoshav, vetzarich biat mayim chayyim, ufatur min hakkarban. raa shalosh, chayyav bakkarban. chazar lihyot metzora musgar, metamme bevia, ufatur min happeria umin happerima umin hattiglachat umin hatztzipporim. veim haya muchlat, chayyav bechullan. perash mimmennu evar sheen alav basar karauy, metamme vemagga uvemassa, veeno metamme veohel. veim yesh alav basar karauy, metamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel. shiur basar karauy, kede lehaalot arucha. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh bemakom echad kede lehakkifo vechut erev, yesh bo lehaalot arucha:
1.6: Eser kedushshot hen, eretz yisrael mekuddeshet mikkol haaratzot. uma hi kedushshatah, shemmeviim mimmenna haomer vehabbikkurim ushete hallechem, ma sheen meviim ken mikkol haaratzot:
1.7: Ayarot hammukkafot choma mekuddashot mimmenna, shemmeshallechim mittochan et hammetzoraim, umesabbevin letochan met ad sheyyirtzu. yatza, en machazirin oto:
1.8: Lifnim min hachoma mekuddash mehem, sheochlim sham kadashim kallim umaaser sheni. har habbayit mekuddash mimmennu, sheen zavim vezavot, niddot veyoldot nichnasim lesham. hachel mekuddash mimmennu, sheen goyim uteme met nichnasim lesham. ezrat nashim mekuddeshet mimmennu, sheen tevul yom nichnas lesham, veen chayyavim aleha chattat. ezrat yisrael mekuddeshet mimmenna, sheen mechussar kippurim nichnas lesham, vechayyavin aleha chattat. ezrat hakkohanim mekuddeshet mimmenna, sheen yisrael nichnasim lesham ella vishat tzarchehem, lismicha lishchita velitnufa:
1.9: Ben haulam velammizbeach mekuddash mimmenna, sheen baale mumin uferue rosh nichnasim lesham. hahechol mekuddash mimmennu, sheen nichnas lesham shello rechutz yadayim veraglayim. kodesh hakkodashim mekuddash mehem, sheen nichnas lesham ella chohen gadol beyom hakkippurim bishat haavoda. amar rabbi yose, bachamishsha devarim ben haulam velammizbeach shave lahechol, sheen baale mumin, uferue rosh, ushetuye yayin, veshello rechutz yadayim veraglayim nichnasim lesham, uforshin mibben haulam velammizbeach bishat haketara:

2.1: Kele etz, uchele or, uchele etzem, uchele zechuchit, peshutehen tehorim, umekabbelehen temeim. nishberu, taharu. chazar veasa mehem kelim, mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulehabba. kele cheres uchele neter, tumatan shava. mittammein umetammein baavir, umittammein meachorehen, veenan mittammein miggabbehen, usheviratan hi tohoratan:
2.2: Haddakkin shebbichle cheres, vekarkerotehen, vedafnotehen yoshvin shello mesummachin, shiuran, mikkede sichat katan vead log. millog vead sea, birviit. missea vead satayim, bachatzi log. missatayim vead shalosh vead chamesh sein, belog, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, ani eni noten bahen midda, ella, haddakkin shebbichle cheres, vekarkerotehen, vedafnotehen yoshvin shello mesummachin, shiuran mikkede sichat katan vead kederot haddakkot. mehakkederot haddakkot vead chaviyyot ludiyyot, birviit. milludiyyot vead lachmiyyot, bachatzi log. millachmiyyot vead chatzavim gedolim, belog. rabban yochanan ben zakkay omer, chatzavim gedolim, shiuran bishne luggin. happakkim haggelilim vehechaviyyonot, shiur karkerotehen kol shehen, veen lahem defanot:
2.3: Hattehorin shebbichle cheres, tavla sheen lah lizbez, umachta ferutza, veabbuv shel kallain, vesilonot, af al pi chefufin af al pi mekabbelin, vechavkav sheasao lesal happat, utefi shehitkino laanavim, vechavit shel shayyatin, vechavit defuna veshule hammachatz, vehammitta, vehakkisse, vehassafsal, vehashshulchan, vehassefina, vehammenora shel cheres, hare ellu tehorim. ze hakkelal, kol sheen lo toch bichle cheres, en lo achorayim:
2.4: Pannas sheyyesh bo vet kibbul shemen, tame. vesheen bo, tahor. megufat hayyotzrin shehu foteach bah, tehora. veshehu gomer bah, temea. mashpech shel baale vattim, tahor. veshel rochlin, tame, mippene shehu shel midda, divre rabbi yehuda ven betera. rabbi akiva omer, mippene shehu mattehu al tziddo umeriach bo lallokeach:
2.5: Kissuy kadde yayin vechadde shemen, vechissuy chaviot neyarot, tehorin. veim hitkino letashmish, temeim. kesuy hallefas, bizman shehu nakuv veyesh lo chiddud, tahor. im eno nakuv veen lo chiddud, tame, mippene shehi mesannenet letocho et hayyarak. rabbi eliezer bar tzadok omer, mippene shehi hofechet alav et haruneki:
2.6: Gistera shennimtzet bakkivshan, ad shello nigmera melachtah, tehora. mishshennigmera melachtah, temea. titros, rabbi eliezer bar tzadok metaher. rabbi yose metamme, mippene shehu chemotzi ferutot:
2.7: Hattemein shebbichle cheres, tavla sheyyesh lah lizbez, umachta shelema, vetavla shehi melea kearot. nitmet achat mehem besheretz, lo nitmeu chullam. im yesh lah lizbez odef, nitmea achat mehem, nitmeu chullan. vechen bet tevalin shel cheres, vekalmarim hammetoamot. uvet tevalin shel etz, shennitma echad bemashke, lo nitma chavero. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, cholkin et avyo. hameshammesh lattame, tame. hameshammesh lattahor, tahor. im yesh lo lizbez odef, nitma achad mehem, nitma chavero:
2.8: Hallappid, tame. uvet shiko shel ner, mittamme vaavir. hammasrek shel tzartzur, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein:

3.1: Shiur keli cheres littaher, heasuy leochalin, shiuro vezetim. heasuy lemashkin, shiuro vemashkin. heasuy lechach ulechach, mattilin oto lechumro vezetim:
3.2: Chavit, shiurah bigrogarot, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer, beegozim. rabbi meir omer, bezetim. hallefas vehakkedera, shiuran bezetim. happach vehattefi, shiuran beshamen. vehatztzartzur, shiuro vemayim. rabbi shimon omer, shelashtan bezeronin. ner, shiuro veshamen. rabbi eliezer omer, bifruta ketanna. ner shennittal piv, tahor. veshel adama shehussak piv bappetila, tahor:
3.3: Chavit shennikkeva vaasaah bezefet, venishbera, im yesh bimkom hazzefet machazik reviit, temea, mippene shello vatal shem keli mealeha. cheres shennikkav vaasao vezefet, af al pi machazik reviit, tahor, mippene shebbatal shem keli mealav:
3.4: Chavit shennitroaa utefalah biglalim, af al pi shehu notel et haggelalim vehacharasim noflim, temea, mippene shello vatal shem keli mealeha. nishbera vedibbek mimmenna charsit, o shehevi charsit mimmakom acher utefalan biglalim, af al pi shehu notel haggelalim vehacharasin omdim, tehora, mippene shebbatal shem keli mealeha. haya vah cheres machazik reviit, kullah mittamma vemagga, uchenegdo mittamme vaavir:
3.5: Hattofel keli cheres habbari, rabbi meir verabbi shimon metammeim. vachachamim omrim, hattofel et habbari, tahor. veet haraua, tame. vechen bechidduk hakkeruya:
3.6: Yabbelit shettoflin bah happittasin, hannogea bah, tame. megufat chavit, enah chibbur. hannogea betippulo shel tannur, tame:
3.7: Mecham shettefalo vechomer uvecharsit, hannogea bachomer, tame. uvacharsit, tahor. kumekum shennikkav vaasao vezefet, rabbi yose metaher, sheeno yachol lekabbel et hachammin ketzonen. vechen haya omer bichle zefet. kele nechoshet shezzefatan, tehorin. veim leyayin, temein:
3.8: Chavit shennikkeva vaasaah bezefet yater mitztzarkah, hannogea betzarkah, tame. yater mitztzarkah, tahor. zefet shennatfa al hechavit, hannogea bah, tahor. mashpech shel etz veshel cheres sheppekako vezefet, rabbi elazar ben azarya metamme. rabbi akiva metamme veshel etz, umetaher beshel cheres. rabbi yose metaher bishnehem:

4.1: Hacheres sheeno yachol laamod mippene azno, o shehaya vo chiddud vehachiddud machrio, tahor. nittela haozen, nishbar hachiddud, tahor. rabbi yehuda metamme. chavit shennifchata, vehi mekabbelet al dafnoteha, o shennechleka chemin shete arevot, rabbi yehuda metaher, vachachamim metammein:
4.2: Chavit shennitroaa veenah yechola lehittaltel bachatzi kav gerogarot, tehora. gistera shennitroaa veenah mekabbelet mashkin, af al pi shehi mekabbelet ochalin, tehora sheen sheyarin lishyarin:
4.3: Ezo hi gistera, kol shennittelu azneha. hayu vah chiddudin yotzin, kol hamekabbel immah bezetim, mittamme vemagga uchenegdo mittamme vaavir. vechol sheeno mekabbel immah bezetim, mittamme vemagga veen kenegdo mittamme vaavir. hayta mutta al tziddah kemin kattedra, kol hamekabbel immah bezetim, mittamme vemagga uchenegdo mittamme vaavir. vechol sheeno mekabbel immah bezetim, mittamme vemagga veen kenegdo mittamme vaavir. shule korfiyyot veshule kosim hatztzidoniyyim, af al pi sheenam yecholim leshev shello mesummachin, temein, shellechach naasu mittechillatan:
4.4: Keli cheres sheyyesh lo shalosh sefayot, happenimit odefet, hakkol tahor. hachitzona odefet, hakkol tame. haemtzait odefet, mimmenna velifnim, tame. mimmenna velachutz, tahor. hayu shavot, rabbi yehuda omer, cholkin haemtzait. vachachamim omrim, hakkol tahor. kele cheres, meematay mekabbelin tuma, mishsheyyitztzarfu vakkivshan, vehi gemar melachtan:

5.1: Tannur, techillato arbaa, usheyarav arbaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bamme devarim amurim, begadol. aval bekatan, techillato kol shehu, usheyarav rubbo, mishshettiggamer melachto. ezehu gemar melachto, mishsheyyassikennu kede leefot bo sufganin. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyassik et hechadash, kede leefot bayyashan sufganin:
5.2: Kira, techillatah shalosh, usheyareha shalosh, mishshettiggamer melachtah. ezehu gemar melachtah, mishsheyyassikenna, kede levashshel aleha vetza kalla shebbabbetzim, terufa unetuna veilpas. hakkuppach, asao laafiyya, shiuro kattannur. asao levishshul, shiuro kakkira. haeven hayyotze min hattannur tefach, umin hakkira shalosh etzbaot, chibbur. hayyotze min hakkuppach, asao laafiyya, shiuro kattannur. asao levishshul, shiuro kakkira. amar rabbi yehuda, lo amru tefach, ella ven hattannur velakkotel. hayu shene tannurin semuchim ze laze, noten laze tefach velaze tefach, vehashshear tahor:
5.3: Ateret kira, tehora. tirat hattannur, bizman shehi gevoha arbaa tefachim, mittammea vemagga uvaavir. pechuta mikkan, tehora. im chibberah lo, afillu al shalosh avanim temea. bet happach uvet hattevalin uvet hanner shebbakkira, mittammein bemagga veenan mittammein baavir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yishmael metaher:
5.4: Tannur shehussak meachorav, o shehussak shello ledato, o shehussak bevet haumman, tame. maase shennafla deleka vetannure chefar signa, uva maase leyavne, vetimmean rabban gamliel:
5.5: Musaf hattannur shel baale vattim, tahor. veshel nachtomin, tame, mippene shehu somech alav et hashshappud. rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer, mippene shehu ofe vo keshehu nidchak. kayyotze vo, musaf hayyora shel sholke zetim, tame. veshel tzabbaim, tahor:
5.6: Tannur shennatan bo afar ad chetzyo, meafar ulemattan, mittamme vemagga. meafar ulemalan, mittamme vaavir. netano al pi habbor o al pi haddut, venatan sham even, rabbi yehuda omer, im massik millemattan, vehu nissok milmalan, tame. vachachamim omrim, hoil vehussak mikkol makom, tame:
5.7: Tannur shennitma, ketzad metaharin oto. cholko lishlosha, vegorer et hattefela ad sheyyehe vaaretz. rabbi meir omer, eno tzarich ligror et hattefela, velo ad sheyyehe vaaretz, ella memaato mibbifnim arbaa tefachim. rabbi shimon omer, vetzarich lehassio. chilleko lishnayim, echad gadol veechad katan, haggadol tame vehakkatan tahor. chalako lishlosha, echad gadol kishnayim, haggadol tame, ushenayim hakketannim tehorin:
5.8: Chatacho chulyot lerachbo, pachot mearbaa tefachim, tahor. mercho vetit, mekabbel tuma mishsheyyassikennu kede leefot bo sufganin. hirchik mimmennu et hattefela venatan chol o tzeror bentayim, baze amru, hannidda vehattehora ofot bo vehu tahor:
5.9: Tannur shebba mechuttach mibbet haumman, veasa vo limmudin, venotnan alav vehu tahor, nitma. vesillek et limmudav, tahor. hecheziran lo, tahor. mercho vetit, mekabbel tuma, veeno tzarich lehassikennu, shekkevar hussak:
5.10: Chatacho chulyot venatan chol ben chulya lechulya, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein. ze tannuro shel achnay. yorot haarviyyin shehu chofer baaretz vetach betit, im yachol hattiach laamod bifne atzmo, tame. veim lav, tahor. veze tannuro shel ben dinay:
5.11: Tannur shel even veshel mattechet, tahor, vetame mishshum kele mattachot. nikkav, nifgam, nisdak, asa lo tefela, o musaf shel tit, tame. kamma yehe vannekev, kede sheyyetze vo haur. vechen bechira. kira shel even veshel mattechet tehora, utemea mishshum kele mattachot, nikkeva, nifgema, nisdeka, asa lah pitputin, temea. merchah betit ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, tehora. rabbi yehuda omer, mibbifnim temea, umibbachutz tehora:

6.1: Haose shelosha fitputim baaretz vechibberan betit lihyot shofet alehen et hakkedera, temea. kava shelosha masmerin baaretz lihyot shofet alehen hakkedera, af al pi sheasa verosho makom shettehe hakkedera yoshevet, tehora. haose shete avanim kira vechibberam betit, temea. rabbi yehuda metaher, ad sheyyaase shelishit, o ad sheyyismoch lakkotel. achat betit veachat shello vetit, tehora:
6.2: Haeven shehaya shofet aleha veal hattannur, aleha veal hakkira, aleha veal hakkuppach, temea. aleha veal haeven, aleha veal hassela, aleha veal hakkotel, tehora. vezo hayta kirat hannezirim shebbirushalayim, shekkeneged hassala. kirat hattabbachim, bizman shehu noten even betzad even, nitmet achat mehen, lo nitmeu chullan:
6.3: Shalosh avanim sheasaan shete chirayim, nitmet achat min hachitzona, haemtzait hameshammeshet et hattemea, temea. hameshammeshet hattehora, tehora. nittela hattehora, huchleta haemtzait letuma. nittela hattemea, huchleta haemtzait lithora. nitmeu shetayim hachitzonot, im hayta haemtzait gedola, noten lazo chede shefita mikkan velazo chede shefita mikkan, vehashshear tahor. veim hayta ketanna, hakkol tame. nittela haemtzait, im yachol lishpot aleha yora gedola, temea. hechezirah, tehora. merchah betit, mekabbelet tuma mishsheyyassikenna kede levashshel aleha et habbetza:
6.4: Shete avanim sheasaam kira venitmeu, samach lazo even achat mikkan, velazo even achat mikkan, chetzyah shel zo temea vechetzyah tehora, vechetzyah shel zo temea vechetzyah tehora. nittelu tehorot, chazru ellu letumatan:

7.1: Hakkalatut shel baale vatim shennifchata fachot mishshelosha tefachim, temea, shehu massik millemattan ukedera veshela milmalan. yater mikkan, tehora. natan even o tzeror, tehora. merchah betit, mekabbelet tuma mikkan ulehabba. zo hayta teshuvat rabbi yehuda vetannur shennetano al pi habbor o al pi haddut:
7.2: Dachon sheyyesh bo vet kibbul kederot, tahor mishshum kira, vetame mishshum keli kibbul. hatztzedadin shello, hannogea bahem eno tame mishshum kira. harachav shello, rabbi meir metaher, verabbi yehuda metamme. vechen hakkofe et hassal veose al gabbav kira:
7.3: Kira shennechleka learkah, tehora. ulerachbah, temea. kuppach shennechlak ben learko ben lerachbo, tahor. chatzar hakkira, bizman shehi gevoha shalosh etzbaot, mittammea vemagga uvaavir. pechuta mikkan, mittammea vemagga veenah mittammea vaavir. ketzad meshaarin otah. rabbi yishmael omer, noten et hashshappud milmalan lemattan uchenegdo mittammea vaavir. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, nitmea hakkira, nitmet hechatzer. nitmea hechatzer, lo nitmet hakkira:
7.4: Hayta mufreshet min hakkira, bizman shehi gevoha shalosh etzbaot, mittamma vemagga uvaavir. pechuta mikkan o shehayta chalaka, tehora. pitpute chira, shelosha, shel shalosh etzbaot, mittammeim bemagga uvaavir. pachot mikkan, kol shekken hen temeim, vaafillu hen arbaa:
7.5: Nittal achad mehen, mittammein bemagga veenam mittammeim baavir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon metaher. asa shenayim, ze cheneged ze, mittammein bemagga uvaavir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon metaher. hayu gevohin mishshalosh etzbaot, mishshalosh ulemattan mittammeim bemagga uvaavir, mishshalosh ulemalan mittammein bemagga veenan mittammein baavir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon metaher. hayu meshuchim min hassafa, betoch shalosh etzbaot, mittammeim bemagga uvaavir, chutz mishshalosh etzbaot mittammeim bemagga veenam mittammeim baavir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon metaher:
7.6: Ketzad meshaarin otan. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, noten et hakkanna benehen, min hakkanna velachutz tahor, min hakkanna velifnim, umekom hakkanna tame:

8.1: Hattannur shechatzatzo vinsarim o viriot, nimtza sheretz bemakom echad, hakkol tame. kavveret pechuta ufekuka vekash umeshulshelet laavir hattannur, hashsheretz betochah, hattannur tame. hashsheretz battannur, ochalin shebbetochah temein. verabbi eliezer metaher. amar rabbi eliezer, im hitztzila vemet hechamur, lo tatztzil bichli cheres hakkal. amru lo, im hitztzila vemet hechamur, shekken cholkim ohalim, tatztzil bichli cheres hakkal, sheen cholkim keli chares:
8.2: Hayta shelema, vechen hakkuppa, vechen hachemet, hashsheretz betochah, hattannur tahor. hashsheretz battannur, ochalin shebbetochah tehorin. nikkevu, heasuy leochalin, shiuran bezetim. heasuy lemashkin, shiuran bemashkim. heasuy lechach ulechach, mattilim oto lechumro, bechones mashke:
8.3: Sereda shehi netuna al pi hattannur veshokaat letocho veen lah gappayim, hashsheretz betochah, hattannur tame. hashsheretz battannur, ochalim shebbetochah, temein, sheen matztzilin miyyad keli cheres ella chelim. chavit shehi melea mashkin tehorin, unetuna lematta minnechushto shel tannur, hashsheretz battannur, hechavit vehammashkin tehorin. hayta chefuya ufiha laavir hattannur, hashsheretz battannur, mashke tofeach shebbeshule hechavit tahor:
8.4: Kedera shehi netuna vattannur, hashsheretz battannur, hakkedera tehora, sheen keli cheres metamme chelim. haya vah mashke tofeach, nitma vetimmeah. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani:
8.5: Tarnegol shebbala et hashsheretz venafal laavir hattannur, tahor. veim met, tame. hashsheretz shennimtza vattannur, happat shebbetocho, sheniyya, shehattannur techilla:
8.6: Bet seor mukkaf tzamid patil venatun letoch hattannur, hasseor vehashsheretz betocho vehakkeretz bentayim, hattannur tame vehasseor tahor. veim haya chazzayit min hammet, hattannur vehabbayit tame, vehasseor tahor. im yesh sham poteach tefach, hakkol tame:
8.7: Hashsheretz shennimtza vaayin shel tannur, baayin shel kira, baayin shel kuppach, min hassafa happenimit velachutz, tahor. veim haya vaavir, afillu chazzayit min hammet, tahor. veim yesh sham poteach tefach, hakkol tame:
8.8: Nimtza mekom hannachat haetzim, rabbi yehuda omer, min hassafa hachitzona velifnim, tame. vachachamim omrim, missafa happenimit velachutz, tahor. rabbi yose omer, mikkeneged shefitat hakkedera velifnim, tame. mikkeneged shefitat hakkedera velachutz, tahor. nimtza mekom yeshivat habballan, mekom yeshivat hatztzabba, mekom yeshivat shel sholke zetim, tahor. en tame ella min hassetima velifnim:
8.9: Bor sheyyesh bo vet shefita, tame. veshel ose zechuchit, im yesh bo vet shefita, tame. kivshan shel sayyadin veshel zaggagin veshel yotzrim, tehora. furena, im yesh lah lizbez, temea. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh lah istegiyyot. rabban gamliel omer, im yesh lah sefayot:
8.10: Magga teme met, shehayu ochalin umashkin letoch piv, hichnis rosho laavir hattannur tahor, timmeuhu. vetahor shehayu ochalin umashkin letoch piv vehichnis rosho laavir hattannur tame, nitmau. haya ochel devela veyadayim mesoavot, hichnis yado letoch piv littol et hatztzeror, rabbi meir metamme, rabbi yehuda metaher. rabbi yose omer, im hafach, tame. im lo hafach, tahor. haya fundeyon letoch piv, rabbi yose omer, im litzmao, tame:
8.11: Haishsha shennataf chalav middaddeha venafal laavir hattannur, tame, shehammashke metamme leratzon veshello leratzon. hayta gorafto vehikkattah hakkotz veyatza mimmenna dam, o shennichvat venatna etzbaah letoch piha, nitma:

9.1: Machat o tabbaat shennimtzeu vinchushto shel tannur, nirin aval lo yotzim, im ofe et habbatzek vehu nogea bahen, tame. beeze vatzek amru, bevatzek habbenoni. nimtzeu vitfelat hattannur mukkaf tzamid patil, im betame, temein. veim betahor, tehorim. nimtzeu vimgufat hechavit, mitztziddeha, temeim, mikkeneged piha, tehorim. nirin betochah aval lo laavirah, tehorin. shokim betochah vetachtehem kiklippat hashshum, tehorin:
9.2: Chavit shehi melea mashkin tehorin umenikat betochah, mukkefet tzamid patil unetuna veohel hammet, bet shammay omrim, hechavit vehammashkin tehorin, umenikat temea. uvet hillel omrin, af menikat tehora. chazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:
9.3: Hashsheretz shennimtza lematta minnechushto shel tannur, tahor, sheani omer, chay nafal veachshav met. machat o tabbaat shennimtzeu lematta minnechushto shel tannur, tahor, sheani omer, sham hayu ad shello va hattannur. nimtzeu veefer mikle, tame, sheen lo vamme yitle:
9.4: Sefog shebbala mashkin temein venaguv mibbachutz venafal laavir hattannur, tame, shessof mashke latzet. vechen chaticha shel lefet veshel gemi. rabbi shimon metaher bishne ellu:
9.5: Charasin shennishtammesh bahen mashkin temein venaflu laavir hattannur, hussak hattannur, tame, shessof mashke latzet. vechen begefet chadasha, aval bishana, tahor. veim yadua sheyyotze mehen mashkin, afillu leachar shalosh shanim, nitma:
9.6: Haggefet vehazzaggin shennaasu vetohora vehalchu alehem temeim, veachar kach yatzu mehen mashkin, tehorin, shemmittechillatan naasu vetohora. kush shebbala et hatztzinnora, malmad shebbala et haddarvan, levena shebbala et hattabbaat, vehen tehorim, nichnesu leohel hammet, nitmau. hesitan hazzav, nitmau. naflu laavir hattannur tahor, timmeuhu. naga bahen kikkar shel teruma, tahor:
9.7: Sereda shehi netuna al pi hattannur mukkaf tzamid patil, nisdak min hattannur lassereda, shiuro melo fi mardea shello nichnas. rabbi yehuda omer, nichnas. nisdeka sereda, shiuro chimlo fi marde nichnas. rabbi yehuda omer, shello nichnas. haya agol, en roin oto aroch, ella shiuro chimlo fi mardea nichnas:
9.8: Tannur shennikkav meeno, shiuro melo chush nichnas veyotze dolek. rabbi yehuda omer, shello dolek. nikkav mitztziddo, shiuro chimlo chush nichnas veyotze shello dolek. rabbi yehuda omer, dolek. rabbi shimon omer, min haemtza, nichnas. min hatztzad, eno nichnas. vechen haya omer bimgufat hechavit shennikkeva, shiurah melo mitza sheniyya shel shifon. min haemtza, nichnas. min hatztzad, eno nichnas. vechen haya omer bachatzavim gedolim shennikkevu, shiuram melo mitza sheniyya shel kane. min haemtza, nichnas. min hatztzad, eno nichnas. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shennaasu leyayin, aval im naasu lishar mashkin, afillu chol shehu, temeim. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shello naasu vide adam. aval im naasu vide adam, afillu chol shehu, temeim. nikkevu, heasuy loochalim, shiuran bezetim. heasuy lemashkim, shiuran bemashkim. heasuy lechach ulechach, mattilim oto lechumro, betzamid patil uvechones mashke:

10.1: Ellu chelim matztzilin betzamid patil, kele gelalim, kele avanim, kele adama, kele cheres, uchele neter, atzmot haddag veoro, atzmot chayya shebbayyam veorah, uchele etz hattehorim. matztzilim ben mippihem ben mitztziddehen, ben yoshvin al shulehen ben muttin al tziddehen. hayu chefuyim al pihen, matztzilim kol shettachtehen ad hattehom. rabbi eliezer metamme. al hakkol matztzilin, chutz mikkele cheres, sheeno matztzil ella al hoochalim veal hammashkin veal kele chares:
10.2: Bamme makkifim. besid uvegippesis, bezefet uveshaava, betit uvetzoa, bechomer uvecharsit, uvechol davar hammitmareach. en makkifim lo bevaatz velo veoferet, mippene shehu fatil veeno tzamid. en makkifin lo vidvela shemena, velo bevatzek shennillosh beme ferot, shello yeviennu lide fesul. veim hikkif, hitztzil:
10.3: Megufat hechavit hamechulchelet veenah nishmetet, rabbi yehuda omer, matztzelet. vachachamim omrim, enah matztzelet. haya vet etzba shellah shokea betochah, hashsheretz betochah, hechavit temea. hashsheretz bechavit, ochalin shebbetochah temeim:
10.4: Hakkaddur vehappekaat shel gemi shennetanan al pi hechavit, im merach min hatztzedadin, lo hitztzil, ad sheyyemarach milmalan umillemattan. vechen bematlit shel beged. hayta shel neyar o shel or, ukesharah bimshicha, im merach min hatztzedadin, hitztzil:
10.5: Chavit shennitkallefa vehazzefet shellah omedet, vechen kevosim shel muryas sheggefatan im hassafa, rabbi yehuda omer, enam matztzilin. vachachamim omrim, matztzilin:
10.6: Chavit shennikkeva usetamuha shemarim, hitztziluha. pekakah bizmora, ad sheyyemarach min hatztzedadim. hayu shetayim, ad sheyyemarach min hatztzedadin uven zemora lachavertah. neser shehu natun al pi hattannur, im merach min hatztzedadin, hitztzil. hayu shenayim, ad sheyyemarach min hatztzedadin uven neser lachavero. asaan besinin o veshogmin, eno tzarich lemareach min haemtza:
10.7: Tannur yashan betoch hechadash usereda al pi hayyashan, nittal hayyashan usereda nofelet, hakkol tame. veim lav, hakkol tahor. chadash betoch hayyashan usereda al pi hayyashan, im en ben chadash lassereda foteach tefach, kol shebbechadash tahor:
10.8: Lefasin zo vetoch zo vesiftotehen shavot, hashsheretz baelyona o vattachtona, hi temea vechullan tehorot. hayu vechones mashke, hashsheretz baelyona, kullan temeot. battachtona, hi temea vechullan tehorot. hashsheretz baelyona, vehattachtona odefet, hi vehattachtona temea. baelyona, vehattachtona odefet, kol sheyyesh bah mashke tofeach, temea:

11.1: Kele mattachot, peshutehen umekabbelehen temein. nishberu, taharu. chazar veasa mehen keli, chazru letumatan hayeshana. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo lechol tuma, ella letumat hannafesh:
11.2: Kol keli mattachot sheyyesh lo shem bifne atzmo, tame, chutz min haddelet, umin hanneger, umin hammanul, vehappota shettachat hatztzir, vehatztzir, vehakkora, vehatztzinnor, shennaasu lakkarka:
11.3: Haose chelim min haeshet, umin hacharara, umin hassovev shel galgal, umin hattassin, umin hatztzippuyin, mikkanne chelim, umeogne chelim, meazne chelim, min hashshecholet, umin haggerudot, tehorin. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, af min hakketzutzot. mishshivre chelim, min haggerutim, umin hammasmerot, sheyyadua shennaasu mikkeli, temein. min hammasmerot, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin:
11.4: Barzel tame shebbelalo im barzel tahor, im rov min hattame, tame. veim rov min hattahor, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. vechen min hachalama umin haggelalim. kelostera, temea. umetzuppa, tehora. happin, vehappurena, temein. vehakkelostera, rabbi yehoshua omer, shomtah mippetach ze vetolah bachavero beshabbat. rabbi tarfon omer, hare hi lo kechol hakkelim, umittaltelet bechatzer:
11.5: Akrav shel perumbeya, temea. ulechayayim, tehorim. rabbi eliezer metamme vallechayayim. vachachamim omrim, en tame ella akrav. uvishat chibburan, hakkol tame:
11.6: Pika shel mattechet, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. umetzuppa, tehora. hakkush, vehaimma, vehammakkel, vesimponya, vechalil shel mattechet, temein. umetzuppin, tehorim. simponya, im yesh bah bet kibbul kenafayim, ben kach uven kach temea:
11.7: Keren agulla, temea. ufeshuta, tehora. im hayta metzuppit shellah shel mattechet, temea. hakkav shellah, rabbi tarfon metamme, vachachamim metaharin. uvishat chibburan, hakkol tame. kayyotze vo, kene menora, tehorin. happerach vehabbasis, temeim. uvishat chibburan, hakkol tame:
11.8: Kasda, temea. ulechayayim, tehorim. im yesh bahen bet kibbul mayim, temeim. kol kele hammilchama, temeim. hakkidon, hannikon, vehammaggafayin, vehashshiryon, temein. kol tachshite nashim, temeim. ir shel zahav, katlayot, nezamim vetabbaot, vetabbaat, ben sheyyesh lah chotam uven sheen lah chotam, nizme haaf. katla shechulyot shellah shel mattachot bechut shel pishtan o shel tzemer, nifsak hachut, hachulyot temeot, shekkol achat veachat keli vifne atzmah. chut shel mattachot, vechulyot shel avanim tovot umargaliyyot, veshel zechuchit, nishtabberu hachulyot, hachut bifne atzmo kayyam, tame. sheyare katla, kimlo tzavvar ketanna. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu tabbaat achat, temea, shekken tolin batztzavvar:
11.9: Nezem shehu asuy kikdera millemattan vechaadasha milmalan, venifrak, kikdera tame mishshum keli vet kibbul, vechaadasha tame vifne atzmo. tzinnora, tehora. heasuy kemin eshkol, venifrak, tahor:

12.1: Tabbaat adam, temea. tabbaat behema vechelim ushear kol hattabbaot, tehorot. korat hachitztzim, temea. veshel asirin, tehora. hakkolar, temea. shalshelet sheyyesh bah bet neila, temea. haasuya lichfita, tehora. shalshelet shel sitonot, temea, shel baale vattim tehora. amar rabbi yose, ematay, bizman shehu mafteach echad, aval im hayu shenayim, o shekkashar chillazon beroshah, temea:
12.2: Kene moznayim shel sarokot, tame, mippene unkelayot. veshel baale vattim, im yesh bo unkelayot, tame. unkelin shel kattafin, tehora. veshel rochlim, temea. rabbi yehuda omer, shel rochlim, shellefanav temea, veshelleacharav tehora. unkeli dargash, temea. veshel naklitin, tehora. shel shidda, temea. veshel akon, tehora. shel shulchan, tame. shel menorat haetz, tahor. ze hakkelal, kol hamechubbar lattame, tame. vehamechubbar lattahor, tahor. vechullan, achat achat bifne atzman, tehorot:
12.3: Kissuy teni shel mattechet, shel baale vattim, rabban gamliel metamme, vachachamim metaharin. veshel rofim, tame. haddelet shebbammigdal, shel baale vattim, tehora. veshel rofim, temea. hayyattuchin, temeim. vehapperachin, tehorin. akrav bet habbad, temea. veunkeli shebbakketalim, tehora:
12.4: Masmer haggara, tame. veshel even hashshaot, tahor. rabbi tzadok metamme. masmer haggardi, tame. vearon shel garosot, rabbi tzadok metamme, vachachamim metaharin. hayta agala shellah shel mattechet, temea:
12.5: Masmer shehitkino lihyot poteach venoel bo, tame. heasuy lishmira, tahor. masmer shehitkino lihyot poteach bo et hechavit, rabbi akiva metamme. vachachamim metaharin, ad sheyyitzrefennu. masmer shel shulchani, tahor. verabbi tzadok metamme. shelosha devarim rabbi tzadok metamme, vachachamim metaharin. masmer shel shulchani, vearon shel garosot, umasmer shel even hashshaot, rabbi tzadok metamme, vachachamim metaharin:
12.6: Arbaa devarim rabban gamliel metamme, vachachamim metaharin. kissuy teni shel mattechet shel baale vattim, uteloy hammagredot, vegolme chele mattachot, vetavla shennechleka lishnayim. umodim chachamim lerabban gamliel betavla shennechleka lishnayim, echad gadol veechad katan, shehaggadol tame vehakkatan tahor:
12.7: Dinar shennifsal vehitkino litloto vetzavvar ketanna, tame. vechen sela shennifsela vehitkinah lihyot shokel bah, temea. ad kamma tippasel vihe rashshay lekayyemah, ad shene dinarin. pachot mikkan, yakotz:
12.8: Haolar, vehakkulmos, vehammetutelet, vehammishkalot, vehakkurim, vehakkan, vehakkanna, temeim. vechol golme chele etz, temeim, chutz mishshel eshkeroa. rabbi yehuda omer, af gerofit shel zayit, tehora, ad shettishshalek:

13.1: Hassayif, vehassakkin, vehappigyon, veharomach, maggal yad umaggal katzir, vehashshechor vezug shel sapparim, shennechelku, hare ellu temein. rabbi yose omer, hassamuch layyad, tame. vehassamuch larosh, tahor. misperet shennechleka lishnayim, rabbi yehuda metamme, vachachamim metaharin:
13.2: Koligrifon shennittela chappah, temea mippene shinnah. nittela shinnah, temea mippene chappah. michchol shennittal hakkaf, tame mippene hazzachar. nittal hazzachar, tame mippene hakkaf. machtev shennittal hakkotev, tame mippene hammochek. nittal hammochek, tame mippene hakkotev. zoma listera shennittela chappah, temea mippene hammazleg. nittal hammazleg, temea mippene chappah. vechen hashshen shel mader. shiur kullan, kede laasot melachtan:
13.3: Charchur shennifgam, tame, ad sheyyinnatel rubbo. nishbar mekofo, tahor. kurdom shennittal ushpo, tame mippene vet bikkuo. nittal bet bikkuo, tame mippene ushpo. nishbar mekofo, tahor:
13.4: Magrefa shennittela chappah, temea mippene shehi chekurnas, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim metaharin. megera shennittelu shinneha achat mibbentayim, tehora. nishtayyer bah melo hassit bemakom echad, temea. hammaatzad vehaizmel vehammafselet vehammakdeach, shennifgemu, temeim. nittal chissuman, tehorin. vechullan shennechleku lishnayim, temeim, chutz min hammakdeach. veharukeni vifne atzmah, tehora:
13.5: Machat shennittal charirah o uktzah, tehora. im hitkinah lemittuach, temea. shel sakkayin shennittal charirah, temea, mippene shehu chotev bah. nittal uktzah, tehora. shel mittuach, ben kach uven kach temea. machat sheheelta chaludda, im meakkevet et hattefira, tehora. veim lav, temea. tzinnora sheppeshatah, tehora. kefafah, chazra letumatah:
13.6: Etz hameshammesh et hammattechet, tame. vehammattechet hameshammesh et haetz, tehora. ketzad, potachat shel etz vehappin shellah shel mattechet, afillu achat, temea. potachat shel mattechet vehappin shellah shel etz, tehora. tabbaat shel mattechet vechotam shellah shel almog, temea. tabbaat shel almog vechotam shellah shel mattechet, tehora. hashshen shebbattas, shebbappotachat, veshebbammafteach, temea bifne atzmah:
13.7: Hakkaddumin haashkelonin shennishberu vehaunkeli shellahen kayyemet, hare ellu temein. hammaber, vehammazre, vehammaggov, vechen masrek shel rosh shennittela achat mishshinnehen, vaasaan shel mattechet, hare ellu temein. veal kullan amar rabbi yehoshua, devar chiddush chiddeshu sofrim, veen li ma ashiv:
13.8: Masrek shel pishtan shennittelu shinnav venishtayyer bo shetayim, tame. veachat, tahor. vechullan, achat achat bifne atzman, temeot. veshel tzemer shennittelu shinnav achat mibbentayim, tahor. nishtayyer bo shalosh bemakom echad, tame. hayta hachitzona achat mehen, tahor. nittelu mimmennu shetayim vaasaan lemalketet, temeot. achat vehitkinah lener o lemittuach, temea:

14.1: Kele mattachot, kamma hu shiuran. haddeli, kede lemallot bo. kumkum, kede lechem bo. mecham, kede lekabbel selaim. hallefes, kede lekabbel kitonot. kitonot, kede lekabbel perutot. middot yayin, beyayin. umiddot shemen, beshamen. rabbi eliezer omer, kullan bifrutot. rabbi akiva omer, hamechussar chatifa, tame. vehamechussar letisha, tahor:
14.2: Makkel sheasa verosho masmer kemin chazyana, tame. simmero, tame. rabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyaase vo shelosha sedarim. vechullan sheasaan lenoy, tehorin. asa verosho menikat, vechen baddelet, tehora. hayta cheli vechibberah lo, temea. meematay hi tohoratah, bet shammay omrim, mishsheyyechabbel. bet hillel omrim, mishsheyyechabber:
14.3: Hakkantar shel bannay, vehaddakor shel charash, hare ellu temein. yitdot ohalim veyitdot hammashochot, temeot. shalshelet shel mashochot, temea. haasuya laetzim, tehora. shalshelet deli gadol, arbaa tefachim. veshel katan, asara. chamor shel nappachin, tame. megera sheasa shinneha vetoch hachor, temea. asaah millemattan lemalan, tehora. vechol hakkesuyin tehorim, chutz mishshel mecham:
14.4: Hattemein shebbaagala, haol shel mattechet, vehakkatrav, vehakkenafayim hamekabbelot et hartzuot, vehabbarzel shettachat tzavvere vehema, hassomech, vehammachger, vehattamchuyot, hainbal, vehatztzinnora, umasmer hamechabber et kullan:
14.5: Hattehorin shebbaagala, haol hametzuppe, kenafayim haasuyot lenoy, ushefofarot hammashmiot et hakkol, vehaavar shebbetzad tzavvere vehema, hassovev shel galgal, hattassim, vehatztzippuyim, ushear kol hammasmerot, tehorin. sandele vehema shel mattachot, temein. shel shaam, tehorin. hassayif meematay mekabbel tuma, mishsheyyeshufennu. vehassakkin, mishsheyashchizenna:
14.6: Kesuy teni shel mattechet sheasa vo mara, rabbi yehuda metaher, vachachamim metammein. mara shennishbera, im enah mara et rov happanim, tehora:
14.7: Kele mattachot mittammein umittaharin shevurin, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, enan mittaharin ella shelemin. ketzad, hizza alehen, nishberu vo vayyom, hittichan vechazar vehizza alehen shenit bo vayyom, hare ellu tehorin, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, en hazzaya pachot mishshelishi ushevii:
14.8: Mafteach shel arkubba shennishbar mittoch arkubbato, tahor, rabbi yehuda metamme, mippene shehu foteach bo mibbifnim. veshel gam shennishbar mittoch gummo, tahor. hayu vo chafin unekavin, tame. nittelu chafin, tame mippene nekavin. nistattemu nekavin, tame mippene chafin. nittelu chafin venistattemu nekavin, o sheppartzu ze letoch ze, tahor. mesannenet shel chardal shennifretzu vah shelosha nekavim millemattan ze letoch ze, tehora. vehaafarkes shel mattachot, temea:

15.1: Kele etz, kele or, kele etzem, kele zechuchit, peshutehen tehorin, umekabbelehen temeim. nishberu, taharu. chazar veasa mehen kelim, mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulehabba. hashshidda, vehatteva, vehammigdal, kavveret hakkash, vechavveret hakkanim, uvor sefina alekkesanderit, sheyyesh lahem shulayim, vehen machazikin arbaim sea velach, shehem korayim beyavesh, hare ellu tehorin. ushear kol hakkelim, ben mekabbelin, ben enam mekabbelin, temein, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, dardur agala, vekustot hammelachim, vaarevat haabbedanin, uvor sefina ketanna, vehaaron, af al pi shemmekabbelin, temein, sheenan asuyin littaltel ella vema shebbetochan. ushear kol hakkelim, hammekabbelim, tehorin, vesheenan mekabbelin, temein. en ben divre rabbi meir ledivre rabbi yehuda ella arevat baal habbayit:
15.2: Aruvot shel nachtomim, temeot. veshel baale vattim, tehorot. serkan o chirkeman, temeot. daf shel nachtomin shekkevao vakkotel, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammeim. serod shel nachtomin, tame. veshel baale vattim, tahor. gippefo mearba ruchotav, tame. nifratz meruach achat, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, im hitkino lihyot koretz alav, tame. vechen hammaaroch, tame:
15.3: Yam nafa shel sillatin, tame. veshel baale vattim, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, af shel godelet tame moshav, mippene shehabbanot yoshvot betocho vegodlot:
15.4: Kol hatteloyim, temein, chutz mitteloy nafa uchevara shel baal habbayit, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, kullan tehorin, chutz mitteloy nafa shel sillatin, uteloy kivrat geranot, uteloy maggal yad, uteloy makkel habballashin, mippene shehen mesayyein bishat hammelacha. ze hakkelal, heasuy lesayyea bishat melacha, tame. heasuy litloy, tahor:
15.5: Rachat shel garosot, temea. shel otzarot, tehora. shel gittot, temea. shel geranot, tehora. ze hakkelal, heasuy lekabbala, tame. lechinnus, tahor:
15.6: Nivle hashshara, temein. venivle vene levi, tehorin. kol hammashkin, temein. umashke vet matbechayya, tehorin. kol hassefarim metammein et hayyadayim, chutz missefer haazara. hammarkof, tahor. habbatnon, vehanniktemon, vehaerus, hare ellu temeim. rabbi yehuda omer, haerus tame moshav, mippene shehaallayit yoshevet alav. metzuddat hachulda, temea. veshel haachbarin, tehora:

16.1: Kol keli etz shennechelak lishnayim, tahor, chutz mishshulchan hakkaful, vetamchuy hammiznon, vehaefiforin shel baale habbayit. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammages, vekod habbavli kayyotze vahen. kele etz, meematay mekabbelin tuma. hammitta vehaarisa, mishsheyyeshufem beor haddag. gamar shello lashuf, temea. rabbi meir omer, hammitta, mishsheyyesareg bah shelosha vattim:
16.2: Hassallim shel etz, mishsheyyachsom vikannev. veshel temara, af al pi shello kinnev mibbifnim, tame, shekken mekayyemin. kalkala, mishsheyyachsom vikannev veyigmor et hatteloya. bet halleginin, uvet hakkosot, af al pi shello kinnev mibbifnim, tame, shekken mekayyemin:
16.3: Hakkenonin hakketannim, vehakkelatot, mishsheyyachsom vikannev. hakkenonim haggedolim, vehassugin haggedolim, mishsheyyaase shene durim larochav shellahem. yam nafa, uchevara, vechaf shel moznayim, mishsheyyaase dur echad larochav shellahen. hakkuppa, mishsheyyaase shete tzefirot larochav shellah. vehearak, mishsheyyaase vo tzefira echat:
16.4: Kele or, meematay mekabbelin tuma. hatturemel, mishsheyyachsom vikannev veyaase kichotav. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyaase et aznav. sekorteya, mishsheyyachsom vikannev veyaase et tzitzatah. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyaase et tabbeoteha. katavolya, mishsheyyachsom vikannev. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyaase et kichoteha. hakkar vehakkeset shel or, mishsheyyachsom vikannev. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyitperem vishayyer bahem pachot mechamishsha tefachim:
16.5: Patilya, temea. vachasina, tehora. signiyyot shel alin, tehorot. shel netzarin, temeot. chotal shehu noten letocho venotel mittocho, tame. veim eno yachol ad sheyyikraennu o ad sheyyattirennu, tahor:
16.6: Kesaya shel zore geranot, shel holche derachim, shel ose fishtan, temea. aval shel tzabbain veshel nappachin, tehora. rabbi yose omer, af shel garosot kayyotze vahen. ze hakkelal, heasuy lekabbala, tame. mippene hazzea, tahor:
16.7: Hammalkot shel bakar, vehechasim shello, vehammaddaf shel devorim, vehammenafa, hare ellu tehorin. kesuy shel kufsa, tame. kesuy kamtera, tahor. kesuy teva, kesuy teni, vehammachbesh shel charash, vehakkeset shettachat hatteva, vehakkimron shellah, veangelin shel sefer, bet hanneger, bet hammanul, uvet hammezuza, vetik nevalin, vetik kinnoret, vehaemum shel godle mitznafot, vehammarkof shel zammar, ureviit shel allayit, ugenognit heani, vesamochot hammitta, utefus shel tefilla, veemum shel ose sutot, hare ellu tehorim. ze hakkelal, amar rabbi yose, kol meshammeshe meshammeshav shel adam bishat melacha veshello vishat melacha, tame. vechol sheeno ella vishat melacha, tahor:
16.8: Tik hassayif vehassakkin vehappigyon, tik misperet umisparayim vehattaar, tik michchol, uvet hakkochal, tik machtev, uterunetek, tik tavla usekorteya, bet hachitztzim, bet happagoshot, hare ellu temeim. tik simponya, bizman shehu noten milmala, tame. mitztziddo, tahor. tik chalilin, rabbi yehuda metaher, mippene shehu notno mitztziddo. chippuy haalla, hakkeshet, veharomach, hare ellu tehorin. ze hakkelal, heasuy letik, tame. lechippuy, tahor:

17.1: Kol kele vaale vattim, shiuran berimmonim. rabbi eliezer omer, bema shehen. kuppot haggannanim, shiuran baaguddot shel yarak. shel baale vattim, beteven. shel ballanin, bigvava. rabbi yehoshua omer, kullan berimmonim:
17.2: Hachemet, shiurah bifkaiyyot shel sheti. im enah mekabbelet shel sheti, af al pi shemmekabbelet shel erev, temea. bet kearot sheeno mekabbel kearot, af al pi shemmekabbel et hattamchuyin, tame. bet hari sheeno mekabbel mashkin, af al pi shemmekabbel et hari, tame. rabban gamliel metaher, mippene sheen mekayyemin oto:
17.3: Hassallin shel pat, shiuran bechikkarot shel pat. efifyarot sheasa lahen kanim millemattan lemala lechizzuk, tehora. asa lah gappayim kol shehen, temea. rabbi shimon omer, im enah yechola lehinnatel baggappayim, tehora:
17.4: Harimmonim sheamru, shelosha, achuzin ze vaze. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, benafa uvichvara, kede sheyyittol vihallech, uvekuppa, kede sheyyafshil laachorav. ushear kol hakkelim sheenan yecholin lekabbel rimmonim, kegon harova, vachatzi harova, hakkenonim hakketannim, shiuran berubban, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer, bezetim. nifretzu, shiuran bezetim. nigmemu, shiuran bema shehen:
17.5: Harimmon sheamru, lo katan velo gadol ella venoni. ulema huzkeru rimmone vadan, sheyyehu mekaddeshin kol shehen, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, leshaer bahen et hakkelim. rabbi akiva omer, lechach ulechach huzkeru, leshaer bahen et hakkelim, veyihyu mekaddeshin kol shehen. amar rabbi yose, lo huzkeru rimmone vadan vachatzire geva, ella sheyyihyu mitasserin vadday bechol makom:
17.6: Kabbetza sheamru, lo gedola velo ketanna ella venonit. rabbi yehuda omer, mevi gedola shebbaggedolot uketanna shebbakketannot, venoten letoch hammayim, vecholek et hammayim. amar rabbi yose, vechi mi modieni ezohi gedola veezohi ketanna, ella hakkol lefi dato shel roe:
17.7: Kaggerogeret sheamru, lo gedola velo ketanna ella venonit. rabbi yehuda omer, haggedola shebbeeretz yisrael hi habbenonit shebbammedinot:
17.8: Kazzayit sheamru, lo gadol velo katan ella venoni, ze egori. kasseora sheamru, lo gedola velo ketanna ella venonit, zo midbarit. kaadasha sheamru, lo gedola velo ketanna ella venonit, zo mitzrit. kol hammittaltelin meviin et hattuma boovi hammardea, lo gadol velo katan ella venoni. eze hu venoni, kol shehekkefo tefach:
17.9: Haamma sheamru, baamma habbenonit. ushete ammot haya veshushan habbira, achat al keren mizrachit tzefonit veachat al keren mizrachit deromit. sheal keren mizrachit tzefonit hayta yetera al shel moshe chatzi etzba. sheal keren mizrachit deromit hayta yetera aleha chatzi etzba, nimtzet yetera al shel moshe etzba. velamma amru achat gedola veachat ketanna, ella shehaummanin notlin bakketanna umachazirin baggedola, kede shello yavou lide meila:
17.10: Rabbi meir omer, kol haammot hayu venoniyyot, chutz mimmizbach hazzahav vehakkeren vehassovev vehayesod. rabbi yehuda omer, ammat habbinyan shishsha tefachim, veshel kelim chamishsha:
17.11: Veyesh sheamru bemidda dakka, middot hallach vehayyavesh shiuran baitalki, zo midbarit. veyesh sheamru, hakkol lefi ma shehu adam, hakkometz et hammincha, vehachofen et hakketoret, vehashshote chimlo lugmav beyom hakkippurim, vechimzon shete seuddot laeruv, mezono lechol aval lo leshabbat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, leshabbat aval lo lechol. ellu vaellu mitkavvenin lehakel. rabbi shimon omer, mishshete yadot lechikkar, mishshalosh lekav. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, mikkikkar befundeyon, mearba sein besala:
17.12: Veyesh sheamru vemidda gassa, melo tarvad rakav, kimlo tarvad gadol shel rofim. ugeris negaim, kaggeris hakkilki. haochel beyom hakkippurim kakkotevet haggassa, kamoha uchegarinatah. venodot yayin vashemen, shiuran kefika gedola shellahen. umaor shello naasa vide adam, shiuro chimlo egrof gadol, ze hu egrofo shel ben batiach. amar rabbi yose, yeshno cherosh gadol shel adam. veshennaasa vide adam, shiuro chimlo makdeach gadol shel lishka, shehu chefundeyon haitalki, uchesela hanneronit, vechimlo nekev shebbaol:
17.13: Kol shebbayyam tahor, chutz mikkelev hammayim, mippene shehu voreach layyabbasha, divre rabbi akiva. haose chelim min haggadel bayyam vechibber lahem min haggadel baaretz, afillu chut, afillu meshicha, davar shehu mekabbel tuma, tame:
17.14: Veyesh beme shennivra vayyom harishon tuma, bashsheni en bo tuma, bashshelishi yesh bo tuma, barvii uvachamishi en bahem tuma, chutz mikkenaf haoz uvetzat naamit hametzuppa. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ma nishtanna chenaf haoz mikkol hakkenafayim. vechol shennivra vayyom hashshishshi, tame:
17.15: Haose cheli kibbul, mikkol makom, tame. haose mishkav umoshav, mikkol makom, tame. haose chis meor hammatztza, min hanneyar, tame. harimmon, haallon, vehaegoz, shechakakum hattinokot lamod bahem et heafar o shehitkinum lechaf moznayim, tame, sheyyesh lahem maase veen lahem machashava:
17.16: Kene moznayim vehammachok sheyyesh bahen bet kibbul mattachot, vehaesel sheyyesh bo vet kibbul maot, vekane shel ani sheyyesh bo vet kibbul mayim, umakkel sheyyesh bo vet kibbul mezuza umargaliyyot, hare ellu temein. veal kullan amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay, oy li im omar, oy li im lo omar:
17.17: Tachtit hatztzorfim, temea. veshel nappachin, tehora. mashchezet sheyyesh bah bet kibbul shemen, temea. vesheen bah, tehora. pinkas sheyyesh bah bet kibbul shaava, temea. vesheen bah, tehora. machatzelet hakkash ushefoferet hakkash, rabbi akiva metamme, verabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher. rabbi shimon omer, af shel pakkuot kayyotze vahen. machatzelet kanim veshel chelef, tehora. shefoferet hakkane shechatachah lekabbala, tehora, ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkachay:

18.1: Hashshidda, bet shammay omrim, nimdedet mibbifnim. uvet hillel omrim, nimdedet mibbachutz. modim ellu vaellu sheen ovi haraglayim voovi lizbezin nimdad. rabbi yose omer, modim sheovi haraglayim voovi lizbezin nimdad, uvenehem eno nimdad. rabbi shimon shezuri omer, im hayu haraglayim gevohot tefach, en benehem nimdad. veim lav, benehen nimdad:
18.2: Mucheni shellah, bizman shehi nishmetet, enah chibbur lah, veenah nimdedet immah, veenah matztzelet immah beohel hammet, veen gorrin otah beshabbat bizman sheyyesh betochah maot. veim enah nishmetet, chibbur lah, venimdedet immah, umatztzelet immah beohel hammet, vegorrin otah beshabbat af al pi sheyyesh betochah maot. hakkimron shellah, bizman shehu kavua, chibbur lah venimdad immah. veim eno kavua, eno chibbur lah veeno nimdad immah. ketzad moddin oto, rosh tor. rabbi yehuda omer, im enah yechola laamod bifne atzmah, tehora:
18.3: Hashshidda vehatteva vehammigdal shennittela achat meraglehen, af al pi shemmekabbelin, tehorin. vesheenan mekabbelin kedarkan, rabbi yose metamme. venaklite hammitta vachamor vechippuy, tehorin. en tame ella mitta umalben. umalbene vene levi, tehorin:
18.4: Malben shennetano al leshonot, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda metammein, rabbi yose verabbi shimon metaharin. amar rabbi yose, ma shana ze mimmalbene vene levi, shemmalbene vene levi tehorin:
18.5: Mitta shehayta temea midras, nittela ketzara ushete cheraayim, temea. arukka ushete cheraayim, tehora. rabbi nechemya metamme. gadad shete leshonot lochsan, gadad shete cheraayim (tefach al tefach) lochsan, o shemmiatah pachot mittefach, tehora:
18.6: Mitta shehayta temea midras, nishbera arukka vetikkenah, temea midras. nishbera sheniyya vetikkenah, tehora min hammidras, aval temea magga midras. lo hispik letakken et harishona ad shennishbera sheniyya, tehora:
18.7: Kera shehayta temea midras, vechibberah lammitta, kullah temea midras. persha, hi temea midras, vehammitta magga midras. hayta temea tumat shiva vechibberah lammitta, kullah temea tumat shiva. persha, hi temea tumat shiva, vehammitta temea tumat arev. hayta temea tumat erev vechibberah lammitta, kullah temea tumat arev. persha, hi temea tumat erev, vehammitta tehora. vechen hashshen shel mader:
18.8: Tefilla, arbaa chelim. hittir ketzitza harishona vetikkenah, temea teme met, vechen sheniyya, vechen shelishit. hittir et harviit, tehora mitteme met, aval temea magga teme met. chazar larishona vehittirah vetikkenah, temea vemagga, vechen sheniyya. hittir et hashshelishit, tehora, sheharviit bemagga, veen magga ose magga:
18.9: Mitta shennignav chetzyah, o avad chetzyah, o chalakuha achin, o shuttafin, tehora. hecheziruha, mekabbelet tuma mikkan ulehabba. mitta mittammea chavila, umittaheret chavila, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, mittammea evarim, umittaheret evarim:

19.1: Hamefarek et hammitta lehatebilah, vehannogea bachavalin, tahor. hachevel meematay hu chibbur lammitta, mishsheyyesareg bah shelosha vattim. vehannogea min hakkesher velifnim, tame. min hakkesher velachutz, tahor. nime hakkesher, hannogea betzarko, tame. vechamma hu tzarko, rabbi yehuda omer, shalosh etzbaot:
19.2: Hachevel hayyotze min hammitta, ad chamishsha tefachim, tahor. mechamishsha vead asara, tame. measara velachutz, tahor, shebbo koshrin et happesachim, umeshalshelin et hammittot:
19.3: Mizran hayyotze min hammitta, kol shehu, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, ad asara tefachim. sheyare mizran, shiva tefachim, kede laasoto chevek lachamor:
19.4: Nissa hazzav al hammitta veal hammizran, metamme shenayim ufosel echad, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, nissa hazzav al hammitta veal hammizran, asara tefachim, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. measara velachutz, metamme echad ufosel echad. nissa al hammizran, measara velifnim, tame. measara velachutz, tahor:
19.5: Mitta shehayta temea midras, vecharach lah mizran, kullah temea midras. persha, hi temea midras, vehammizran magga midras. hayta temea tumat shiva, vecharach lah mizran, kullah temea tumat shiva. persha, hi temea tumat shiva, vehammizran tame tumat arev. hayta temea tumat erev, vecharach lah mizran, kullah temea tumat arev. persha, hi temea tumat erev, vehammizran tahor:
19.6: Mitta shekkarach lah mizran, venaga bahen hammet, temein tumat shiva. pershu, temein tumat shiva. naga bahen hashsheretz, temein tumat arev. pershu, temein tumat arev. mitta shennittelu shete arukkot shellah veasa lah chadashot, velo shinna et hannekavim, nishtabberu chadashot, temea. vishanot, tehora, shehakkol holech achar hayeshanot:
19.7: Teva sheppitchah milmala, temea teme met. nifchata milmala, temea teme met. nifchata millematta, tehora. megurot shebbah, temeot, veenam chibbur lah:
19.8: Hatturemel shennifchata kis shebbetocho, tame, veeno chibbur lo. hachemet shebbetzim shellah mekabbelot immah, venifchatu, tehorot, sheenam mekabbelot kedarkan:
19.9: Teva sheppitchah mitztziddah, temea midras uteme met. amar rabbi yose, ematay, bizman sheenah gevoha asara tefachim, o sheen lah lizbez tefach. nifchata milmalan, temea teme met. nifchata millemattan, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim metaharin, mippene shebbatal haikkar, batla hattefela:
19.10: Mishpelet shennifchata millekabbel rimmonim, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim metaharim, mippene shebbatal haikkar, batla hattefela:

20.1: Hakkarim vehakkesatot vehassakkin vehammartzufin shennifchatu, hare ellu temeim midras. hakkelusetar, arbaa kabbin, hatturemel chameshet kabbin, hakkeretit sea. hachemet shel shivat kabbin, rabbi yehuda omer, af harivtzal vehammizvada kol shehen, hare ellu temein midras. vechullam shennifchatu, tehorim, mippene shebbatal haikkar, uvatla hattefela:
20.2: Chemet chalilin, tehora min hammidras. arevat pisonot, bet shammay omrim, midras. uvet hillel omrim, teme met. areva mishshene log vead tisha kabbin shennisdeka, temea midras. hinnichah baggeshamim venitpecha, temea teme met. bakkadim venisdeka, mekabbelet midras. ze chomer bishyare chele etz mibbitchillatan. vechomer bishyare chele netzarim mibbitchillatan, shemmittechillatan enam mekabbelim tuma ad sheyyitchassemu. nitchassemu, af al pi shennashru siftotehen kol shehen, temein:
20.3: Makkel sheasao bet yad lekurdom, chibbur lattuma bishat melacha. haddeyusetar, chibbur lattuma bishat melacha. kevao vichlonas, tame, veeno chibbur lah. asa lo deyusetar, en tame ella tzarko. kisse shekkevao vichlonas, tame, veeno chibbur lo. asa vo chisse, en tame ella mekomo. kevao vekorat bet habbad, tame, veeno chibbur lah. asa veroshah kisse, tahor, mippene sheomrin lo, amod venaase et melachtenu:
20.4: Areva gedola shennifchata millekabbel rimmonim, vehitkinah lishiva, rabbi akiva metamme. vachachamim metaharin, ad sheyyekatztzea. asaah evus labbehema, af al pi shekkevaah bakkotel, temea:
20.5: Kofet shekkevao venidbach, kevao velo vana alav, bana alav velo kevao, tame. kevao uvana alav, tahor. mappatz shennetano al gabbe hakkorot, kevao velo natan alav et hammaaziva, natan alav et hammaaziva velo kevao, tame. kevao venatan alav et hammaaziva, tahor. keara shekkevaah beshidda teva umigdal, kederech kabbalatah, temea. shello chederech kabbalatah, tehora:
20.6: Sadin shehu teme midras vaasao vilon, tahor min hammidras, aval tame teme met. meematay hi tohorato. bet shammay omrim, mishsheyyittaver. bet hillel omrim, mishsheyyikkasher. rabbi akiva omer, mishsheyyikkavea:
20.7: Machatzelet sheasa lah kanim learkah, tehora. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyaase chemin chi. asaam lerachbah veen ben kane lachavero arbaa tefachim, tahor. nechleka lerachbah, rabbi yehuda metaher. vechen hammattir rashe hammaadannin, tehora. nechleka learkah venishtayyeru vah shelosha maadannim shel shishsha tefachim, temea. machatzelet, meematay mekabbelet tuma. mishshettikkanev, vehi gemar melachtah:

21.1: Hannogea bakkoved haelyon, bakkoved hattachton, bannirim, uvakkeros, uvechut sheheeviro al gabbe argaman, uveira sheeno atid lehachazirah, tahor. benefesh hammassechet, uvashsheti haomed, uvechaful sheheeviro al gabbe haargaman, uveira shehi atida lehachazirah, tame. hannogea batztzemer sheal haimma, baashvaya, tahor. hannogea bappika, ad shello ferah, tame. mishshepperah, tahor:
21.2: Hannogea baol, uvakkatrav, baayin, uvaavot, afillu vishat melacha, tahor. bacherev, uvabborech, uvayyatzul, tame. baayin shel mattechet, ballechayayin, uvaarayin, tame. rabbi yehuda metaher ballechayayim, sheenam asuyin ella lerabbot et heafar:
21.3: Hannogea beyad megera, mikkan umikkan, tame. bachut, uvammeshicha, baamma, uvassenifin, bammachbesh shel charash, uvakkashtanit, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, af hannogea bammalben shel massar haggadol, tahor. hannogea bayyeter uvakkeshet, af al pi shehi metucha, tahor. metzuddat haeshut, tehora. rabbi yehuda omer, kol zeman shehi metucha, chibbur:

22.1: Hashshulchan vehaddelufki shennifchatu, o shechippan beshayish veshiyyer bahem mekom hannachat hakkosot, temeim. rabbi yehuda omer, mekom hannachat chatichot:
22.2: Hashshulchan shennittela achat meraglav, tahor. nittela sheniyya, tahor. nittela hashshelishit, tame kesheyyachshov alav. rabbi yose omer, en tzarich machashava. vechen haddelufki:
22.3: Safsal shennittal achad merashav, tahor. nittal hashsheni, tahor. im yesh bo gova tefach, tame. sherafraf shennittal achad merashav, tame. vechen hakkisse shellifne kattedra:
22.4: Kisse shel kalla shennittelu chippuyav, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin. shammay omer, af malben shel kisse, tame. kisse shekkevao vaareva, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin. shammay omer, af heasuy bah:
22.5: Kisse shello hayu chippuyav yotzin, venittelu, tame, shekken darko lihyot mattehu al tziddo veyoshev alav:
22.6: Kisse shennittal chippuyo haemtzai vehachitzonim kayyamim, tame. nittelu hachitzonim vehaemtzai kayyam, tame. rabbi shimon omer, im haya rachav tafach:
22.7: Kisse shennittelu shenayim mechippuyav ze vetzad ze, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. amar rabbi yehuda, af kisse shel kalla shennittelu chippuyav venishtayyer bo vet kabbala, tahor, mippene shebbatal haikkar uvatla hattefela:
22.8: Shidda shennittal haelyon, temea mippene hattachton. nittal hattachton, temea mippene haelyon. nittal haelyon vehattachton, rabbi yehuda metamme mippene haddappin, vachachamim metaharin. yeshivat hassattat, tame midras:
22.9: Kofet shesserko, vechirkemo, vaasao fanim, rabbi akiva metamme. vachachamim metaharin, ad sheyyachok bo. hassal vehakkalkala shemmilan teven o mochin, hitkinan lishiva, tehorin. sergan begemi o vimshicha, temein:
22.10: Haasla, temea midras uteme met. persha, haor tame midras, vehabbarzel tame teme met. hatteraskal shechippuyo shel or, tame midras uteme met. persha, haor tame midras, vehatteraskal tahor mikkelum. safsalin shebbammerchatz ushete raglav shel etz, tame. achat shel etz veachat shel even, tahor. hannesarin shebbammerchatz sheshshiggeman, rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin, sheenam asuyin ella sheyyihyu hammayim mehallechin tachtehen. kankelin sheyyesh bah bet kabbalat kesut, temea. vehaasuya kechavveret, tehora:

23.1: Hakkaddur vehaimmum vehakkamea vehattefillin shennikreu, hannogea bahen, tame. uvema shebbetochan, tahor. haukkaf shennikra, hannogea bema shebbetocho, tame, mippene shehattefer mechabbero:
23.2: Ellu temein mishshum merkav, zarez haashkeloni, umedocha hammadit, veavit shel gamal, vetappetan shel sus. rabbi yose omer, af tappetan shel sus tame mishshum moshav, mippene sheomdin alav bakkumpon. aval ukkaf shel naka, tame:
23.3: Ma ben merkav lemoshav. merkav chalak maggao mimmassao, umoshav lo chalak maggao mimmassao. tafit shel chamor shehu yoshev aleha, tahor. shinna vah et hannekavin, o sheppertzan ze letoch ze, temea:
23.4: Hammitta vehakkar vehakkeset shel met, hare ellu temein midras. kisse shel kalla, umashber shel chayya, vechisse shel koves shehu chorem alav et hakkelim, amar rabbi yose, en bahem mishshum moshav:
23.5: Hacherem, tame mippene hazzuto. harshatot, vehammichmarot, vehammaddaf, vehappelatzur, umetzuddot hassecharin, temein. vehaakon, vehartov, vehakkeluv, tehorin:

24.1: Shelosha terisin hem. teris hakkafuf, tame midras. veshemmesachakin bo bakkunpon, tame teme met. veditzat haarviyyin, tehora mikkelum:
24.2: Shalosh agalot hen. haasuya chekattedra, temea midras. kemitta, temea teme met. veshel avanim, tehora mikkelum:
24.3: Shalosh arevot hen. areva mishshene log vead tisha kabbin shennisdeka, temea midras. shelema, temea teme met. vehabbaa vammidda, tehora mikkelum:
24.4: Shalosh tevot hen. teva sheppitchah mitztziddah, temea midras. milmalan, temea teme met. vehabbaa vammidda, tehora mikkelum:
24.5: Shelosha tarbusin hen. shel sapparin, tame midras. sheochlin alav, tame teme met. veshel zetim, tahor mikkelum:
24.6: Shalosh besasiyyot hen. shellifne hammitta veshellifne sofrim, temea midras. veshel delufki, temea teme met. veshel migdal, tehora mikkelum:
24.7: Shalosh pinkasiyyot hen. haefiforin, temea midras. vesheyyesh bah bet kibbul shaava, temea teme met. vachalaka, tehora mikkelum:
24.8: Shalosh mittot hen. haasuya lishchiva, temea midras. shel zaggagin, temea teme met. veshel saragin, tehora mikkelum:
24.9: Shalosh mashpelot hen. shel zevel, temea midras. shel teven, temea teme met. vehappuchlatz shel gemallim, tahor mikkelum:
24.10: Shelosha mappatzim hen. haasuya lishiva, temea midras. shel tzabbain, tame teme met. veshel gittot, tahor mikkelum:
24.11: Shalosh chamatot veshalosh turemlin hen. hamekabbelim kashshiur, temein midras. vesheenan mekabbelin kashshiur, temeim teme met. veshel or haddag, tahor mikkelum:
24.12: Shelosha orot hen. heasuy leshatiach, tame midras. letachrich hakkelim, tame teme met. veshel retzuot veshel sandalim, tehora mikkelum:
24.13: Shelosha sedinin hen. heasuy lishchiva, tame midras. levilon, tame teme met. veshel tzurot, tahor mikkelum:
24.14: Shalosh mitpachot hen. shel yadayim, tame midras. shel sefarin, temea teme met, veshel tachrich veshel nivle vene levi, tehora mikkelum:
24.15: Shelosha ferakilinin hen. shel tzade chayya vaof, tame midras. shel chagavin, tame teme met. veshel kayyatzin, tahor mikkelum:
24.16: Shalosh sevachot hen. shel yalda, temea tumat midras. shel zekena, temea teme met. veshel yotzet lachutz, tehora mikkelum:
24.17: Shalosh kuppot hen. mehuha shettelayah al habberiyya, holchin achar habberiyya. ketanna al haggedola, holchin achar haggedola. hayu shavot, holchin achar happenimit. rabbi shimon omer, kaf moznayim shettelayah al shule hammecham, mibbifnim, tame. mibbachutz, tahor. telayah al tziddah, ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, tahor:

25.1: Kol hakkelim yesh lahem achorayim vatoch, kegon hakkarim vehakkesatot vehassakkin vehammartzufin, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, kol sheyyesh lo tovrot, yesh lo achorayim vatoch. vechol sheen lo tovrot, en lo achorayim vatoch. hashshulchan vehaddelufki, yesh lahem achorayim vatoch, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, en lahem achorayim. vechen tavla sheen lah lizbez:
25.2: Hammardea yesh lo achorayim vatoch, mishshiva lacharchur, mearbaa laddarvan, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, en lahem, lo huzkeru arbaa veshiva ella lashsheyarim:
25.3: Middot yayin vashemen, vezoma listera, umesannenet shel chardal, umeshammeret shel yayin, yesh lahen achorayim vatoch, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, en lahem. rabbi shimon omer, yesh lahem. nitmeu meachorehen, ma shebbetochan tahor, vetzarich lehatebil:
25.4: Harova vachatzi harova, nitma harova, lo nitma chatzi harova. nitma chatzi harova, lo nitma harova. amru lifne rabbi akiva, hoil vachatzi harova achorayim larova, keli shennitma tocho lo nitmeu achorav. amar lahen, shel kat kodmin hi, o shemma harova achorayim lachatzi harova, keli shennitmeu achorav, lo nitma tocho:
25.5: Nitma harova, harova vaachorav temein, chatzi harova vaachorav tehorin. nitma chatzi harova, chatzi harova vaachorav temein, harova vaachorav tehorin. nitmeu achore harova, achore chatzi harova tehorin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en cholkin et haggabbayin. ucheshehu matbil, matbil et kullo:
25.6: Kanne chelim, veognehem, veaznehem, vidot hakkelim hamekabbelim, shennaflu alehen mashkin, menaggevan vehem tehorim. ushear kol hakkelim (sheenam yecholin lekabbel rimmonim), sheen lahem achorayim vatoch, shennaflu mashkin al miktzato, kullo tame. keli shennitmeu achorav bemashkin, achorav temeim, tocho veogno veazno veyadav tehorin. nitma tocho, kullo tame:
25.7: Kol hakkelim yesh lahen achorayim vatoch, veyesh lahem bet tzevia. rabbi tarfon omer, laareva gedola shel etz. rabbi akiva omer, lechosot. rabbi meir omer, leyadayim hattemeot vehattehorot. amar rabbi yose, lo amru ella leyadayim hattehorot bilvad:
25.8: Ketzad. hayu yadav tehorot vaachore hakkos temeim, achazo bevet tzeviato, eno choshesh shemma nitmeu yadav baachore hakkos. haya shote vechos sheachorav temeim, eno choshesh shemma nitma hammashke shebbefiv baachore hakkos vechazar vetimme hakkos. kumkum shehu martiach, eno choshesh shemma yatzu mashkin mittocho venagu vaachorav vechazru letocho:
25.9: Kele hakkodesh en lahem achorayim vatoch, veen lahem bet tzevia. veen matbilim kelim vetoch kelim lekodesh. kol hakkelim yordin lide tumatan bemachashava, veenan olim mide tumatan ella veshinnuy maase, shehammaase mevattel miyyad hammaase umiyyad machashava, umachashava enah mevattelet lo miyyad maase velo miyyad machashava:

26.1: Sandal imki, vechis shel shenatzot, rabbi yehuda omer, af kefifa mitzrit, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af sandal ladiki kayyotze vahen, hare ellu mittammein umittaharin shello veumman. amar rabbi yose, vahalo chol hakkelim mittammein umittaharin shello veumman. aval ellu, af al pi shehen muttarin, temein, shehahedyot yachol lehachaziram. lo amru ella vichfifa mitzrit, sheaf haumman eno yachol lehachazirah:
26.2: Kis shel shenatzot shennittelu shenatzav, tame. nifshat, tahor. tala alav et hammatlet millemattan, tame. kis letoch kis, shennitma achad mehen bemashke, lo nitma chavero. tzeror hammargalit, tame. tzeror hammaot, rabbi eliezer metamme, vachachamim metaharim:
26.3: Kaf lokte kotzim, tehora. hazzon vehabbirkeyar, temein. vehashsharvulim, temein. vehapperaklimin, tehorin. vechol bet etzbaot, tehorot, chutz mishshel kayyatzin, mippene shehi mekabbelet et haog. nikrea, im enah mekabbelet et rov haog, tehora:
26.4: Sandal shennifseka achat meaznav vetikkenah, tame midras. nifseka sheniyya vetikkenah, tahor min hammidras aval tame magga midras. lo hispik letakken et harishona ad shennifseka sheniyya, tehora. nifsak akevo, nittal chotmo, o shennechelak lishnayim, tahor. solyam shennifsak mikkol makom, tahor. minal shennifchat, im eno mekabbel et rov haregel, tahor. minal sheal haemum, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammeim. kol chamatot tzerurot, tehorot, chutz mishshel arviyyin. rabbi meir omer, tzeror shaa, tehorot. tzeror olam, temeot. rabbi yose omer, kol chamatot tzerurot, tehorot:
26.5: Ellu orot temein midras, or shechishshav alav leshatiach, or sekorteya, or katavolya, or hachammar, or hakkattan, or hakkattaf, or harofe, or haarisa, or hallev shel katan, or hakkar, or hakkeset, midras. or hassarok, or hassorek, rabbi eliezer omer, midras. vachachamim omrim, teme met:
26.6: Av kesut, vetachrich kesut, midras. av argaman, vetachrich argaman, bet shammay omrim, midras. uvet hillel omrim, teme met. or sheasao chippuy lichli, tahor. lemishkalot, tame. rabbi yose metaher mishshum aviv:
26.7: Kol makom sheen chesron melacha, machashava metammetan. vechol makom sheyyesh chesron melacha, en machashava metammetan, ella hautzba:
26.8: Orot baal habbayit, machashava metammetan. veshel abbedan, en machashava metammetan. veshel gannav, machashava metammetan. veshel gazlan, en machashava metammetan. rabbi shimon omer, chilluf haddevarim, shel gazlan, machashava metammetan. veshel gannav, en machashava metammetan, mippene shello nityaashu habbealim:
26.9: Or shehu tame midras, vechishshav alav lirtzuot ulesandalin, kevan shennatan bo et haizmel, tahor, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyemaatennu fachot mechamishsha tefachim. rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok omer, af haose mitpachat min haor, temea. umin hakkeset, tehora:

27.1: Habbeged mittamme mishshum chamishsha shemot. hassak, mishshum arbaa. haor, mishshum shelosha. haetz, mishshum shenayim. ucheli cheres, mishshum echad. keli cheres mittamme mishshum keli kibbul. kol sheen lo toch bichle cheres, en lo achorayim. musaf alav haetz, shehu mittamme mishshum moshav. vechen tavla sheen lah lizbez, bichle etz, temea, uvichle cheres, tehora. musaf alav haor, shehu mittamme mishshum ohalim. musaf alav hassak, shehu mittamme mishshum arig. musaf alav habbeged, shehu mittamme mishshum shalosh al shalosh:
27.2: Habbeged mittamme mishshum shelosha al shelosha, lemidras, umishshum shalosh al shalosh litme met. hassak arbaa al arbaa, haor chamishsha al chamishsha, mappatz shishsha al shishsha, shavin lemidras velitme met. rabbi meir omer, hassak sheyarav arbaa, utechillato mishsheyyiggamer:
27.3: Haose shenayim min habbeged veechad min hassak, shelashtan min hassak veechad min haor, arbaa min haor veechad min hammappatz, tahor. chamishsha min hammappatz veechad min haor, arbaa min haor veechad min hassak, shelosha min hassak veechad min habbeged, tame. ze hakkelal, kol shechibber lo min hechamur mimmennu, tame. min hakkal mimmennu, tahor:
27.4: Hamekatztzea mikkullam tefach al tefach, tame. mishshule hakkuppa tefach al tefach, tame. mitztzedade hakkuppa, rabbi shimon metaher. vachachamim omrim, hamekatztzea tefach al tefach bechol makom, tame:
27.5: Beloye nafa uchevara shehitkinan lishiva, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin ad sheyyekatztzea. kisse shel katan sheyyesh lo raglayim, af al pi sheen bo gavoah tefach, tame. chaluk shel katan, rabbi eliezer omer, kol shehu. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyihye vo chashshiur, venimdad kaful:
27.6: Ellu nimdadin kefulin. ampalya, ufemolinya, umichnasayim, vechova, vechis shel pundiyya. umatlit shettelayah al hassafa, im peshuta, nimdedet peshuta, veim kefula, nimdedet kefula:
27.7: Habbeged shearag bo shelosha al shelosha, venitma midras, vehishlim alav et kol habbeged, veachar kach natal chut echad mittechillato, tahor min hammidras, aval tame magga midras. natal chut echad mittechillato, veachar kach hishlim alav et kol habbeged, tame magga midras:
27.8: Vechen beged shearag bo shalosh al shalosh, venitma teme met, vehishlim alav et kol habbeged, veachar kach natal chut echad mittechillato, tahor mitteme met, aval tame magga teme met. natal chut echad mittechillato, veachar kach hishlim alav et kol habbeged, tahor, mippene sheamru, shalosh al shalosh shennitmaet, tahor. aval shelosha al shelosha shennitmaet, af al pi shettahor mimmidras, tame vechol hattumot:
27.9: Sadin shehu tame midras, vaasao vilon, tahor min hammidras, aval tame magga midras. amar rabbi yose, vechi veeze midras naga ze. ella im ken naga bo hazzav, tame vemagga hazzav:
27.10: Shelosha al shelosha shennechelak, tahor min hammidras, aval tame magga midras. amar rabbi yose, vechi veeze midras naga ze. ella im ken naga bo hazzav, tame magga hazzav:
27.11: Shelosha al shelosha, baashpot, bari vetzorer melach. babbayit, o vari o tzorer melach. kamma melach yehe tzorer, rova. rabbi yehuda omer, bedakka. vachachamim omrim, begassa. ellu vaellu mitkavvenim lehakel. rabbi shimon omer, shavim shelosha al shelosha vaashpot leshalosh al shalosh babbayit:
27.12: Shelosha al shelosha shennikra, im netano al hakkisse uvesaro nogea bakkisse, tahor, veim lav, tame. shalosh al shalosh shennimha mimmenna chut echad, o shennimtza vo kesher, o shene chutin matimin, tehora. shalosh al shalosh shehishlichah baashpot, tehora. hechezirah, temea. leolam hashelachatah metaharatta, vachazaratah metammetah, chutz mishshel argaman veshel zehorit tova. rabbi eliezer omer, af matlit chadasha kayyotze vahen. rabbi shimon omer, kullan tehorin, lo huzkeru ella mippene hashavat aveda:

28.1: Shalosh al shalosh shennetanah bechaddur, o sheasaah kaddur bifne atzmah, tehora. aval shelosha al shelosha shennetano vechaddur, tame. asao chaddur bifne atzmo, tahor, mippene shehattefer memaato:
28.2: Pachot mishshelosha al shelosha shehitkino lafok bo et hammerchatz, lenaer bo et hakkedera, lekanneach bo et harechayim, ben muchan ben sheeno muchan, tame, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, ben min hammuchan, ben sheeno min hammuchan, tahor. rabbi akiva omer, min hammuchan, tame. sheeno min hammuchan, tahor:
28.3: Haose ispelanit, ben beveged ben beor, tehora. rabbi yose omer, al haor, tahor. melugema, beveged, tehora, uveor, temea. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af beveged, temea, mippene shehi ninaret:
28.4: Mitpechot sefarim, ben metzuyyarot ben sheenan metzuyyarot, temeot, kedivre vet shammay. bet hillel omrim, metzuyyarot, tehorot, vesheenam metzuyyarot, temeot. rabban gamliel omer, ellu vaellu tehorot:
28.5: Kippa shehu tame midras, unetano al hassefer, tahor min hammidras, aval tame teme met. chemet sheasaah shatiach, veshatiach sheasao chemet, tahor. chemet sheasaah turemel veturemel sheasao chemet, kar sheasao sadin vesadin sheasao kar, keset sheasaah mitpachat umitpachat sheasaah keset, tame. ze hakkelal, kol sheshshinnahu lishmo, tame. leshem acher, tahor:
28.6: Matlit shettelayah al hakkuppa, metammea echad ufoselet echad. hifrishah min hakkuppa, hakkuppa metamma echad ufoselet echad, vehammatlit tehora. telayah al habbeged, metamma shenayim ufoselet echad. hifrishah min habbeged, habbeged metamme echad ufosel echad, vehammatlit metammea shenayim ufoselet echad. vechen hattole al hassak o al haor, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon metaher. rabbi yose omer, al haor, tahor. al hassak, tame, mippene shehu arig:
28.7: Shalosh al shalosh sheamru, chutz min hammelal, divre rabbi shimon. vachachamim omrim, shalosh al shalosh mechuvvanet. telayah al habbeged, meruach achat, eno chibbur. mishshete ruchot zo cheneged zo, chibbur. asao chemin gam, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. amar rabbi yehuda, bamme devarim amurim, betallit. aval bechaluk, milmalan, chibbur. umillemattan, eno chibbur:
28.8: Bigde aniyyim, af al pi sheen bahem shalosh al shalosh, hare ellu temein midras. tallit shehitchil bah lekarah, kevan shennikra rubbah, eno chibbur. heavim veharakkim, en bahem mishshum shalosh al shalosh:
28.9: Keset hassabbalin, temea midras. meshammeret shel yayin, en bah mishshum moshav. sevacha shel zekena, temea mishshum moshav. chaluk shel yotzet hachutz heasuy kisvacha, tahor. haose veged min hacherem, tahor. umizzuto, tame. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, af haose veged min hacherem uchefalo, tame:
28.10: Sevacha shehitchil bah mippiha, tehora, ad sheyyigmor et kurekuretah. hitchil bah mikkurekuretah, tehora, ad sheyyigmor et piha. shavis shellah, tame vifne atzmo. hachutin shellah, temein mishshum chibbur. sevacha shennikrea, im enah mekabbelet et rov hassear, tehora:

29.1: Nome hassadin vehassudarin vehattartin vehappilyon shel rosh, shesh etzbaot. shel afkarsin, eser. nime sagos, vehardid, vehechaluk, vehattallit, shalosh etzbaot. nime chippa shel zekena, vehaggumedin shel arviyyin, vehakkulkin, vehappunda, vehammaaforet, vehappargod, nimehen kol shehen:
29.2: Shalosh kesatot shel tzemer, shesh shel pishtan, shelosha sedinin, shetem esre mitpachot, shene suverikin, chaluk echad, tallit echad, keluvkarin echad, chibbur lattuma velahazzaya. yater mikkan, chibbur lattuma, veen chibbur lahazzaya. rabbi yose omer, af lo lattuma:
29.3: Chut hammishkolet, shenem asar. shel charashin, shemona asar. shel bannayin, chamishshim amma. yater mikkan, im ratza lekayyem, tahor. shel sayyadin veshel tzayyarin, kol shehen:
29.4: Chut moznayim shel zehavim veshel shokle argaman tov, shalosh etzbaot. yad hakkurdom meacharav, shalosh etzbaot. rabbi yose omer, tefach, tahor:
29.5: Chut moznayim shel chenvanim, shel baale vattim tefach. yad hakkurdom millefanav, tefach. sheyare yad happargol, tefach. yad makkevet shel yad shel mefatteche avanim, tafach:
29.6: Chut moznayim shel tzammarim, veshel shokle zechuchit, tefachayim. yad hammakkor, tefachayim. yad hammaatzad shel ligyonot, tefachayim. yad hakkurnas shel zehavim, tefachayim. veshel charashin, shelosha tefachim:
29.7: Sheyare haddarvan milmalan, arbaa. yad habbadid, arbaa. yad hakkurdom shel nikkush, chamishsha. yad ben happattish, chamishsha. veshel happattish, shishsha. yad hakkurdom shel bikkua veshel adir, shishsha. veyad makkevet shel sattatin, shishsha:
29.8: Sheyare charchur millemattan, shiva. yad magrefa shel baale vattim, bet shammay omrim, shiva. bet hillel omrim, shemona. shel sayyadin, bet shammay omrim, tisha. bet hillel omrim, asara. yater mikkan, im ratza lekayyem, tame. veyad meshammeshe haur, kol shehu:

30.1: Kele zechuchit, peshutehen tehorin, umekabbelehen temeim. nishberu, taharu. chazar veasa mehen kelim, mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulehabba. hattavla vehaiskutela shel zechuchit, tehorin. im yesh lahen lizbez, temeim. shule keara veshule iskutela shel zechuchit shehitkinan letashmish, tehorin. kirtesan o shafan beshufin, temein:
30.2: Aspaklarya, tehora. vetamchuy sheasao aspaklarya, tame. veim mittechilla asao leshem aspaklarya, tahor. tarvad shehu notno al hashshulchan, im mekabbel kol shehu, tame. veim lav, rabbi akiva metamme, rabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher:
30.3: Kos shennifgam rubbo, tahor. nifgam bo shalosh berubbo, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, im mefazzer hu et rov hammayim, tahor. nikkav, vaasao ben bevaatz ben bezefet, tahor. rabbi yose omer, bevaatz, tame, uvezefet, tahor:
30.4: Tzelochit ketanna shennittal piha, temea. ugedola shennittal piha, tehora. shel palyaton shennittal piha, tehora, mippene shehi sorachat et hayyad. leginin gedolim shennittal pihen, temein, mippene shehu metakkenan lichvashin. vehaafarkes shel zechuchit, tehora. amar rabbi yose, ashrayich kelim, shennichnast betuma, veyatzat betohora:
